zh-CN: 多智能体 A 股研究

summary.zh-CN: 面向 A 股的多智能体研究辅助系统，社区版提供研究、筛选、课程和模拟交易；应用层采用专有许可。
summary.en: A multi-agent A-share research assistant with screening, courses and paper trading; its Community Edition includes a proprietary application layer.

zh-CN: 研究多智能体组织 A 股分析与讨论的流程
通过单股、主题及筛选入口整理研究问题
探索社区版学习课程、技能管理和模拟交易
en: Structure questions through stock, topic and screening tools
Explore community courses, skill management and paper trading

reason.zh-CN: 社区版首发提交新增应用启动和模型能力配置代码。已抽查提交中的实现差异，属于窗口内功能发布；未运行研究或交易。
reason.en: The Community Edition initial commit adds application startup and model-capability code. Selected implementation diffs confirm a functional introduction in the window; research and trading were not executed.
